summary: Implemented the SHACL path parsing feature. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError, and test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py with a module-scoped Turtle fixture and parametrized valid/invalid tests. The new tests and existing test/test_path.py pass (41 passed) under the prepared venv. Nothing committed. Deviations: added an explicit Node isinstance guard so None and plain strings raise SHACLPathError instead of acting as graph wildcards; added one extra test for non-node inputs. black and isort are not installed in the venv, so formatting was checked by hand only.
